summary: Exterior light patterns from the iDrive 6 menu, for a parked car
author: inotbarnacle (packaged by NBTApps)
description:
A menu under My Vehicle that runs patterns on the car's exterior lights while it is parked.

What it does
- Four patterns, Front, Rear, Both and Insane, and a Stop button
- Runs only in Park at zero speed

What you need
- An NBT Evo head unit with iDrive 6 (ID6), on a software version the app was built for (see Good to know)
- NBTApps agent 1.6.0 or later
- The car's diagnostic gateway. The app tries 169.254.21.3, and if nothing answers there, looks for the gateway on the car's wired network
- A car with the lighting module the app supports. It was tested on an F3x car. Other F-series cars may work, and G-series cars have not been tried

After installing
The iDrive screen restarts. Open My Vehicle and choose BEAMer.

Good to know
- An owner reports that it does not run on a car with a dual-clutch gearbox, which has no Park position
- It needs the diagnostic gateway and does not fall back to the car's MOST bus
- The page is laid out for a 1280×480 screen only. On another screen it does not fit
- Owners report that on some cars the app only gets data while a device is plugged into the OBD port
- This package does not check the head unit's software version. The author's own installer accepts only these NBTevo versions: L17252I, M17345I, M17365I, N18032I, N18092I, P18362I, Q18491I, R19101I, R19144I, S19221I, S19322I, T18501I, T23235J, U19384I, V20153I, X20511I, Y21432J, Y22292I, Y23236I and Y24073J. On another version the menu may not load
- If the app was put on this car before, with the author's desktop installer or by hand, uninstall it the same way first. NBTApps refuses to install over it
- If the app does not find the car's diagnostic gateway, put its address in a gateway-ip.txt file on the head unit: /var/opt/hmi/data/ID5/gateway-ip.txt for all of the author's apps at once, or one in the app's own folder. The shared file comes first. This package writes neither
- This is a pre-release: the package has not yet been installed on a car through NBTApps
